scientific_integrity: A self-contained all-order combinatorial proof and standalone finite checker are supplied. The originality assessment is literature-bounded, and no independent validation or historical priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for all n>=3 and the forbidden pattern 001, with reversal and complement equivalents. The cover may include forbidden windows; it is cyclic. Other forbidden factors, linear covers, and minimizer classification remain open here.
title: Fibonacci overhead for cyclic covers of \(001\)-avoiding binary words
